en.html:
Sorimachi"!!"
Sayo"Kindly remain as you are. Otherwise I shall split the spine."
Sorimachi"...The old lady in attendance... So you have come through safely?"
Sayo"For these old bones, a winter swim was a considerable imposition. Since then, this shivering simply will not leave me."
Sayo"When the hand may slip, who can say...? So I must ask you to be very strict with yourself. No suspicious movements, please."
Sorimachi"...Kheh..."
Sorimachi"HYEH!!"

en.html:
Sorimachi"Ghh... hih..."
Sayo"...Such a dog's death. For Lieutenant Colonel Cannon, surely your loyalty was not of the life-and-death variety?"
Sayo"And that merry, marvelous surprise-machine in the sky. As an armor, very interesting, I agree. It is the contents that let the arrangement down—"
Sayo"Amateurs, most of them, are they not? Drugs for the reactions, drugs for the physical ability, and warriors ready in a hurry... Have I understood wrongly?"
Sorimachi"............"
Sayo"Against Muramasa, this will not be sufficient."
Sorimachi"...Heh, heh. Yes..."
Sorimachi"That is what one would think... certainly."
Sayo"...?"
Sorimachi"I wanted to see that bastard win... Wanted to see it for myself..."
Sorimachi"Hiheh... heheheh. Hyehheheheheheheheheh."
Sorimachi"Heh.............................."

雪車町 「ぐっ……ひ……」
さよ 「……犬死をなさる。 　キャノン中佐に命懸けの忠義を捧げていた わけでもありますまい」
さよ 「お空の上の、愉快痛快ビックリマシンも。 　面白い騎体である事は認めますが、惜しむ らくは中身――」
さよ 「あの大半は単なる素人でございましょう？ 　薬物投与で反応速度と運動能力を引き上げ られただけの俄か武者……違いますかな」
雪車町 「…………」
さよ 「村正どのの敵とはなり得ませぬ」
雪車町 「……へ、へ。 　そう……」
雪車町 「そうでしょう……ねェ」
さよ 「……？」
雪車町 「野郎の勝つところ…… 　……見てやりたかったぜぇ……」
雪車町 「ヒヘ……ヘヘ……。 　ヒェッヘヘヘヘヘヘヘヘ」
雪車町 「へ……………………………………」
